california.topic: Prop 19 Primary Residence, 1-Year Deadline & Multi-Unit Rules
california.value: Transferor AND eligible child must use as principal residence within 1 year; BOE-266 due within 1 year for retroactive relief, BOE-19-P within 3 years. Multi-unit: ONLY the single occupied unit qualifies; rental units are 100% reassessed. LLCs ineligible.
california.source_label: CA BOE Letter to Assessors No. 2026/026 (Aug 3, 2026)

california.value: $7,000 assessed value reduction (~$70–$83/yr tax savings); requires BOE-266 filing
When revocable trust becomes irrevocable on death, successor trustee must serve § 16061.7 notice to heirs/beneficiaries within 60 days (triggers 120-day contest window)

legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Eliminated the scheduled 2026 TCJA cliff (~$7M); set federal estate/gift/GST exclusion to $15,000,000 in 2026, indexed for inflation ($15,480,000 in 2027), and made 10%–37% brackets permanent.

legislative_watch_2025_2026.measure: CA Initiative #1994 (AG #25-0017) — Repeal Prop 19 Family Transfer Rules
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Sought to restore Prop 58/193 unlimited principal residence & $1M non-residence inheritance tax-base transfers; did not appear on qualified Nov 2026 or 2028 ballot lists.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Qualified Ballot Measures

legislative_watch_2025_2026.status: Leading / Unofficial Pass (60.6% Yes as of Nov 9, 2026)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Makes permanent the Prop 30/55 high-income surtax brackets (10.3%, 11.3%, 12.3% + 1% MHSA = 13.3% top) instead of expiring in 2031.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Nov 2026 Election Results

legislative_watch_2025_2026.measure: CA Proposition 40 (One-Time Wealth Tax) vs Proposition 42 (Bans Personal Property Taxes)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.status: Unofficial Nov 9, 2026: Prop 40 Failing (47.2% Yes); Prop 42 Leading (51.6% Yes)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Prop 40 proposed a one-time billionaire wealth tax on individuals/trusts; Prop 42 constitutionally prohibits new state taxes on financial/personal property and retroactive taxes.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Nov 2026 Voter Guide & Results

legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Would have exempted principal residences of owners aged 60+ from ad valorem property taxes; failed signature qualification.
